summary.name: JustTags
summary.one_liner: A macOS app for decoding, filtering, comparing and copying BER-TLV EMV tags from base64 or hex strings.
use_cases: Decode BER-TLV EMV data from hex or base64 strings
Compare two tag lists to find differences
Look up tag names, sources, formats and kernel info
Pass tag data from the command line into the app
Copy selected EMV tags as hex
summary.what_it_does: JustTags decodes BER-TLV EMV tags supplied as base64 or hex strings into a readable list. You can filter the decoded tags by tag number, name, or description. For specific tags such as 9F33 or 95, it can fully decode the tag value. It also shows additional tag info (source, format, kernel), lets you select and copy tags as a hex string, diffs two tag lists, and allows renaming window tabs. Command-line input works through a justtags:// custom URL scheme or by piping output into a shell function.
notable: Command-line integration via justtags:// URL scheme and shell piping
Full value decoding for specific tags like 9F33 and 95
Open source under GNU GPLv3, built from Xcode
caveats: Distributed as source only; the page describes building it with Xcode rather than providing a download
Requires macOS and Xcode to build
Command-line piping setup requires editing shell config (~/.zshrc or ~/.bashrc)
